description: Recaudo Derechos Económicos de Hidrocarburos is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Agencia Nacional de Hidrocarburos - ANH, Bogotá D.C.. Conjunto de datos de recaudo de los Derechos Económicos de los Contratos de Exploración y Producción de Hidrocarburos suscritos con la Agencia Nacional de Hidrocarburos y las compañías operadoras. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher Agencia Nacional de Hidrocarburos - ANH, Bogotá D.C.. Its tags are derecho economico, recaudo, hidrocarburos. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Participación Ciudadana. The portal shows 2026-06-24 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
